{{Quote|Have a ''honeyfruit''! They're just the right consistency for&hellip;''splattering!''|Malani, as she pelts a pirate with a honeyfruit|<ref name="Ewoks 2" />}}
A '''honeyfruit''' was a type of [[Color|orange]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was harvested by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Due to its consistency, it was used by [[Malani]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] to repel a [[Zorbian space pirates|Zorbian space pirate]] during the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]' invasion of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="Ewoks 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The honeyfruit was created by writer [[David Manak]] and illustrator [[Warren Kremer]] for the [[Ewoks (1985) 2|second issue]] of [[Marvel Comics]] [[1985]] [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Star Wars: Ewoks'']] comic book series.<ref name="Ewoks 2" />
